rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for precise identification or for stressing that something is exactly so.

example.english: This is exactly the answer I wanted.
example.jyutping: zing3 zing3 hai6 ngo5 soeng2 jiu3 ge3 daap3 on3

rows.note: Use this when an amount, measurement, fit, or timing is exactly right with nothing extra or missing.

example.english: The box is exactly the right size to fit all the cups.
example.traditional: 個盒啱啱好放得晒啲杯。
example.jyutping: go3 hap6 ngaam1 ngaam1 hou2 fong3 dak1 saai3 di1 bui1

rows.note: Use this as a spoken emphatic agreement, especially as a reply meaning “exactly” or “that’s right.”
